| 占位符                               | 含义 / 用法                            |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `(S1) (S2)`                       | 稳定说话者 ID，跨镜头不变；复合如 `(S1,S2)` 表示一起说 |
| `<d>[Language] ...</d>`           | 对白/歌词，**逐字保留原文语言**，只放语言标签+原文，不翻译   |
| `<scenetrans>`                    | 同一句对白跨过一次镜头切换时，连接处用，并说明音频跨越继续      |
| `<cutoff>`                        | 语音被视频结尾截断时使用                       |
| `says in an off-screen voiceover` | 画外音专用短语；其后补一句「画面内角色嘴唇保持闭合」         |

widgets_values:
顺序固定，缺一不可：

1. `subject_definitions` — 定义每条被参考内容及其标签
2. `summary` — `[任务类型]` 前缀 + 目标视频与参考关系概述（如 `[reference generation + audio reference]`）
3. `retention_analysis` — 每条参考如何被保留/转移（用 `fully_preserved` / `partially_preserved` / `attribute_transfer` / `weak_reference`，音频用 `fully_copy` / `partially_copy` / `reference` / `weak_reference`）
4. `detailed_description` — 按播放顺序逐镜头描述（正文英文，对白用 `<d>`，参考标签在首次出现处插入）
5. `overall_soundscape`
6. `non_diegetic_music`

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>, a four-view character sheet (face, front, right-side, and back full-body) presented in a clean anime illustration style; in the target video she is realized as a cinematic photorealistic figure with dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair styled into a high side ponytail secured by a large pink satin bow with a hanging plush dog charm, soft wispy bangs, large expressive brown eyes, and fair skin; she wears a white ribbed camisole with lace neckline under a pale pink short-sleeved open-front knit cardigan, a light grey pleated mini skirt, white knee-high socks, and pale pink sneakers.
<Subject 2> is the breaking-dawn rooftop and open-horizon environment whose look comes from <Picture 2>, a cinematic reference still showing a concrete rooftop terrace edge with diagonal leading lines toward a horizon where deep-indigo night sky splits open into a radiant band of warm gold and peach, volumetric god-rays fanning outward from the breach like an opening gateway, morning mist, floating dust motes, and wind-swept surface texture; no human figure present in the reference.
<Audio 1> is the worship-pop EDM song, reused 1:1 as the complete final audio track for this target video.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] The target video continues <Subject 1>'s chase from the exact state the previous shot ended in — mid full-sprint with her back to camera driving toward <Subject 2>'s golden horizon light — through three internally cut but motion-continuous shots: a low tracking shot from behind-and-beside her carrying the sprint forward, then a hip-level side tracking shot where she throws her head back in a fierce running grin without ever breaking stride, then a dynamic tracking shot catching a powerful skip-jump mid-run. No static beats; motion carries start to finish. <Picture 1> provides her appearance; <Picture 2> provides the dawn environment. <Audio 1> is reused 1:1.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - hairstyle (ponytail with pink bow and charm), outfit (cardigan, camisole, pleated skirt, knee-high socks, pink sneakers), and build retained from <Picture 1>; shown continuing the sprint from the prior shot (back to camera), then a mid-run reaction (head thrown back, fierce grin) without stopping, then a mid-run leap — continuous motion across all three shots, no still poses.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3] background): fully_preserved - the concrete parapet leading line, deep-indigo-to-warm-gold sky split, gateway-style god-rays now widened into a blazing arch and flooding the rooftop, morning mist, wind-swept texture retained from <Picture 2>.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - reused 1:1 as complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic photorealistic style with cool blue night shifting into warm golden-hour color grading, soft volumetric bloom, gentle lens haze, fine 35mm film grain, and a vertical 9:16 frame, the dawn environment following the look of <Subject 2>.
[Shot 1] A low-angle tracking shot from behind-and-slightly-beside <Subject 1> catches her exactly where the previous shot left off — mid full-sprint with her back to camera, driving hard toward <Subject 2>'s towering golden gateway of light on the horizon; her body leans forward into the run, arms pumping in rhythm, dark wavy hair and the pale pink cardigan streaming straight backward from the wind of her speed, the large pink bow whipping; her pink sneakers strike the concrete rooftop in sharp motion-blurred footfalls, the parapet wall and rolling hills beyond streaking past in horizontal blur; the golden band on the horizon has widened into a blazing arch since the last shot, god-rays now flooding downward across the whole rooftop; <Audio 1>'s four-on-the-floor pulse keeps her stride locked to its downbeats. She does not stop — the chase only accelerates.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.778, the camera pulls to a hip-level side tracking shot still moving with her as she runs, and <Subject 1> throws her head back mid-stride with a fierce, breathless grin — teeth showing, eyes crinkling at the corners with exhilaration — yet her legs never break their driving rhythm and her arms keep pumping; the vast golden gateway of light fans its god-rays visibly around her running silhouette, washing her in warm gold; her shoulders shake with released energy but she stays in full forward motion, leaning harder into the next stride. The reaction peaks on a strong downbeat of <Audio 1> — this is the moment the light proves it will not fade.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.185, the camera whips in low and cuts to a dynamic tracking shot capturing <Subject 1> launching a powerful skip-jump forward without breaking her run, one leg driving off the ground while the other swings through, body angled aggressively toward the horizon light, arms pumping laterally; she sails over a seam in the rooftop in a brief weightless arc, the pink cardigan flaring open to reveal the white camisole, hair and bow trailing in the leap; she lands the skip squarely on the next downbeat and immediately drives into the following stride without losing a beat. As <Audio 1> delivers <d>[English] You will never fade away</d>, golden light particles burst again from the horizon toward her and her gaze stays locked forward on the un-fading source, the sprint carrying straight through to the end of the shot. No diegetic dialogue. Holds to end.

overall_soundscape:
Rhythmic footfalls on concrete continue directly from the previous shot, wind rushing past her ears, fabric flapping in acceleration, and a single sharp exhale of exertion on the skip-jump — all continuous with S01.

non_diegetic_music:
<Audio 1> is directly reused — worship-pop EDM continuing its building pre-chorus pulse at approximately 129 BPM, bright synth pads warming, vocal melody entering its first ascending phrase, the line <d>[English] You will never fade away</d> landing as the sprint peaks.

| 标签            | 含义                                | 典型写法                                                                    |
| ------------- | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<Subject N>` | 可复用的**可见内容**（人/动物/物体/场景/服装/风格/动作） | `<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with long dark hair...` |
| `<Picture N>` | 用作**具体目标帧/构图锚点**的参考图（首帧/关键帧/末帧）   | `<Picture 2> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing a woman seated...` |
| `<Video N>`   | 整视频层面的关系：剪辑源、续接起点、镜头运动/节奏来源       | `<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit.`              |
| `<Audio N>`   | 被复制/参考的音频信号（BGM、音色、对白、音效）         | `<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).`         |
